_doc: The groove of item's Line 8 profiles (40 mm modular dimension) in the "light" shape. Opening, width under the lips, depth and lip are item's table of groove dimensions, which is one table for the standard and the light shape: the two take the same nuts; the floor's width and the angle of the flanks are scaled off item's drawing, and say so. The drawn slot leaves out the hollow behind each lip (so it is drawn with more metal than it has) and the rounded mouth. item's groove faces also lean inward by 0.2 mm (its dimension e), so that a fastening pulls them flat: left out here.
name: slot-8-item-light

opening.rule: Groove opening, dimension a: 8.0 +0.4 for Line 8

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip, dimension d: 4.5 +0.3. In the light shape the lip is this thick at its tip and hollowed behind it, to about 2 mm: a hook

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, dimension b: 20.0 +0.4

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the groove's floor, dimension c: 12.25 +0.3

floor_width.rule: Width of the floor, taken where the flanks' lines meet it: the flanks of the light shape stand about 1.7 mm further out than the standard shape's, and round into the floor. Not dimensioned: measure yours
floor_width.source: scaled off item's section drawing of 0.0.026.33, https://cdn.item24.com/product-assets/GRA_PMA_PRF_02633-x_%23SALL_%23AINO_%23V1.svg (the drawing prints no figure for it)

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as drawn. Not dimensioned
flank_angle.source: scaled off item's section drawing of 0.0.026.33, https://cdn.item24.com/product-assets/GRA_PMA_PRF_02633-x_%23SALL_%23AINO_%23V1.svg (the drawing prints no figure for it)

nut_family.rule: It takes the nuts of item's Line 8, as the standard shape does (slot-8-item)
